observations.text: Four washes left pale horizontal lanes.
Crossing washes joined the cloth; an out-of-range endpoint rejected one batch before any marks were added, then corrected.
Rounded block-in had a central blue slit and floated above shadow.
Broad crossing closed slit; warm lower and cool right planes separated.
Dark mouth remained open inside a warm lip and reached shadow.
Single sampled spiral remained continuous, but read as drawn on a flat disk.
Pale spiral neighbor added a slight turn and relief.
Upper rust bands wrapped inward but projected beyond silhouette.
Inset right bands stayed inside edge.
Indigo contour correction added a dark raised arc; pale covers split two bands.
Lower bands stayed inside silhouette and left central coil quiet.
Single loaded oil cover widened and darkened the unwanted arc.
Acrylic changed bare cloth but left existing oil arc visible.
Lighter loaded oil changed dark arc to pale relief; two broken bands reconnected.
Middle-value cover reduced color contrast but left raised arc; inner mouth plane faint.
Warm lip cover shortened bright bottom rim; body joined mouth.
Small unequal rust echoes varied band scale.
Single compact shoulder reflection survived whole view.
Left cloth fold quiet; right fold became a pale angular thread.
Broader curved cloth neighbors retained conspicuous pale ridges.
Inner broad planes gave coil a light side but added raised arcs.
Lower band extensions subtle, with no new protrusions.
Inner pearl plane faint; mouth remained dark and clear.
Reinforced shoulder reflection stayed compact; upper review showed raised crown repair.
Crown joins less abrupt but retained raised steps; lower camera reviewed contact and lip.
Final cool underside stroke crossed shell-to-lip join: concrete placement error requiring correction.
Loaded warm covers removed cool crossing in color, with raised joins remaining. Spiral, reserved mouth and compact reflection retained; stop because further covers mainly add relief.

limitations: All 27 boundaries visually inspected whole and close. Boundary 4 pair observed but not saved. Early pairs through 40 used a fixed crop; some edges were clipped as note layout changed. Later framing uses current canvas-wrap bounds. An initial mislabeled 8 pair captured a rejected batch at 4 marks and was overwritten by the correct completed 8 pair. Upper81 first screenshot had negative crop after auto-scroll; replaced after returning heading to view. No visual QA claim for the rejected/cropped attempts.
